title: Accounts Assistant
description:
Accounts Assistant - Technology - Bedford - 27500 plus benefits

Hello Recruitment is delighted to be recruiting an Accounts Assistant for a technology business based on the outskirts of Bedford.

As Accounts Assistant you will be supporting the Finance & Office Manager doing the sales ledger, chasing debtors and producing month end reports using Sage & Excel.

This is a varied role which will include dealing with project costs and updating them in to Excel, credit card analysis and postings.

The role will traverse general accounts, some bookkeeping and some general administration to give it a nice varied feel in modern offices with good parking.

Ideally you will have some AAT experience but all candidates will be considered on their own merits.

The salary on offer is 27,500 for this immediate start.

title: Bookkeeper
company: Bennett and Game Recruitment LTD - Agency - Permanent
description:
Job Title: Bookkeeper
Location: Leighton Buzzard
Package: Paying up to 35,000, 22 days holiday +BH, pension, flexible hours
Working Hours: Full time or Part time. Standard hours of Mon-Thur 9am-5:30pm and Friday 9am-3pm. Reduced hours and part time can be arranged

A new opportunity has arisen within a highly experienced and reputable accountancy practice in Leighton Buzzard for a Bookkeeper to join their growing team. This practice have been established for 40 years, and currently hold a diverse and supportive team of 14

This is a crucial role in ensuring the practice provide clients with the best possible service. As a Bookkeeper you will be managing monthly and quarterly bookkeeping for a diverse portfolio of clients, payroll, companies house work, and more. If you are looking for a stable environment, and to work for a reputable firm then look no further

Bookkeeper Job Responsibilities
- Undertaking monthly and quarterly bookkeeping for a varied portfolio of clients.
- Processing financial transactions, maintaining accurate records and completing account reconciliations.
- Preparing and assisting with the submission of quarterly VAT returns.
- Supporting clients with Making Tax Digital (MTD) for Income Tax quarterly reporting requirements.
- Assisting with Companies House administration, including the preparation and submission of confirmation statements.
- Liaising with clients to obtain information, resolve queries and ensure records are maintained accurately.
- Utilising accounting software including Sage, Xero and QuickBooks.
- Providing occasional payroll support where required.

Bookkeeper Job Requirements
- At least two years' experience working within an accountancy practice.
- Previous experience undertaking bookkeeping for multiple clients.
- Good working knowledge of Sage, Xero and QuickBooks.
- Experience assisting with VAT returns and reconciliations.
- Understanding of Making Tax Digital requirements would be advantageous.
- Good organisational skills, with the ability to manage workloads and meet deadlines.
- A proactive approach, with the confidence to work independently and use initiative.
- Payroll knowledge or experience would be beneficial but is not essential.
- Able to commute to Leighton Buzzard

Bookkeeper Salary & Benefits
- 28,000- 35,000 depending on experience
- 22 days holiday, plus bank holidays, rising to 25 days after 3 years service
- Flexible working hours, and part time options
- Paid parking permit (after 3 years of service)
- Auto enrolment to company pension
- Standard sick pay contribution
- Collaborative and supportive team, with an excellent office culture

Bennett and Game Recruitment are a multi-disciplined technical recruitment agency based in Chichester, West Sussex operating across the UK with specialist teams covering a range of industries.
We are acting as a Recruitment Agency in relation to this vacancy, and in accordance with GDPR by applying you are granting us consent to process your data, contact you about the services we offer, and submit your CV for the role you have applied for.

title: Finance Assistant
description:
We are working with a well-established, not-for-profit housing association based in Luton who are looking to recruit a motivated and detail-focused Finance Assistant to join their friendly Finance team.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone with previous accounts or finance administration experience who is looking to develop their career within a supportive organisation.

You will gain exposure to a variety of finance functions, including purchase ledger, sales ledger, rent accounting and general financial administration, playing an important role in ensuring the smooth running of day-to-day finance operations.

The Role

Your responsibilities will include:
- Supporting purchase ledger activities, including processing supplier invoices and payments.
- Assisting with sales ledger, raising invoices and processing receipts.
- Supporting rent accounting and maintaining accurate financial records.
- Managing finance correspondence, incoming post and the accounts email inbox.
- Investigating and resolving finance-related queries.
- Providing support to colleagues across the organisation and working collaboratively within the Finance team.
- Ensuring all transactions are processed accurately and in line with financial procedures.

About You

We are looking for someone who is organised, numerate and proactive, with good attention to detail and a genuine interest in finance.

You will ideally have:
- Previous experience working within a finance or accounts department.
- Strong written and verbal communication skills.
- Excellent attention to detail and accuracy.
- A methodical and organised approach, with the ability to manage deadlines.
- The ability to maintain confidential financial information.
- Good problem-solving skills and the confidence to investigate queries.
- The ability to work independently and as part of a team.

Desirable:
- An AAT or other finance-related qualification.
- Experience within social housing or a similar organisation.
- Experience using accounting software.

What's on Offer?

The organisation offers a supportive working environment and an attractive benefits package, including:
- 33 days annual leave, including bank holidays, increasing to 38 days with service.
- Option to buy or sell up to five days' annual leave.
- Free Health Cash Plan following probation.
- Employee Assistance Programme.
- Pension scheme with enhanced employer contributions.
- Life Assurance and Personal Accident Cover.
- Staff benefits portal with shopping discounts.
- Flexible and supportive working environment.

Interested?

If you have previous finance or accounts experience and are looking for an opportunity to develop your skills within a friendly, community-focused organisation, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Finance Assistant
description:
Finance Assistant

Permanenet

Salary 27,000

37 hours per week, Monday to Friday

Based on site in Luton full time for the first 3 months, then agile working available.

Our client is a not-for-profit housing association located in Luton. We have an opportunity for an experienced Finance Assistant to play an important role within the Finance Department in partnership with line managers and employees.

Responsibilities: Finance Assistant
- Administer the incoming and outgoing post and office inbox.
- Maintain rent ledgers, processing receipts, and related administration and housekeeping.
- Maintain purchase ledgers, processing payments, processing invoices and related administration and housekeeping.
- Maintain sales ledgers, processing receipts, raising invoices and related administration and housekeeping.
- Process company cards, applications for new cards and related administration.
- Carry out control account checks for Sales and Purchase Ledgers.
- Reconciliation work for bank accounts, statements and other various reconciliations to resolve queries.
- Assist colleagues from other departments with information, guidance and query resolution.
- Assist in any implementation and administration on tenant portal.
- Investigate accounting queries through to resolution.
- Assist and provide cover as and when required by Finance team.
- Carry out any other appropriate duties as directed by senior finance staff/managers.
- Comply with the requirements of the Financial Regulations.
- Assist in providing timely reports to support business planning.

Skills / Experience: Finance Assistant
- Some previous experience of working within a busy accounting office environment in a similar role.
- Excellent verbal and written communication skills to communicate with all levels of organisation.
- Proficiency in the use of Spreadsheets and Word-processing applications
- Ability to learn to use the relevant software quickly and confidently.
- Excellent organisational skills.
- Ability to work as part of a team as well as using own initiative.
- Ability to manage time well, prioritise workload, and plan in order to handle several tasks simultaneously without losing sight of priorities.
- Ability to adopt a methodical approach and work within systems and procedures.
- Able to handle sensitive data and be competent in maintaining clear and accurate records.
- Attention to detail.
- Ability to work under pressure to tight deadlines.
- Strong reconciliation skills

title: Purchase Ledger Clerk
description:
Finance Coordinator

Full Time Hybrid after training period Cambridgeshire Area

Our client, a well-established and growing organisation, is seeking a highly organised and detail-oriented Finance Coordinator to join their finance team. This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced accounts person looking for a role within a supportive and collaborative environment.

Key Responsibilities include:
- Processing supplier invoices and maintaining accurate supplier ledger records.
- Matching invoices to purchase orders and delivery documentation.
- Preparing and processing payment runs, including BACS and bank payments.
- Reconciling supplier statements and resolving account queries.
- Supporting month-end processes, including accruals and prepayments.
- Processing employee expense claims and related payments.
- Responding to supplier enquiries in a professional and timely manner.
- Assisting with annual audit requirements and ad hoc finance projects.
- Providing general support to the wider finance team as required.

Applications are welcomed from individuals who can demonstrate:
- Previous experience within accounts payable, purchase ledger, or a similar finance function.
- Studying towards or happy to study towards your AAT Studies
- Strong attention to detail and a proactive approach to problem-solving.
- The ability to manage workloads effectively and meet deadlines.
- Good communication skills, both written and verbal.
- Confidence using Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel.
- Experience of working with finance systems.
- The ability to work both independently and as part of a team.

What's on Offer?
- Opportunity to join a stable and growing business.
- Study support for AAT Qualification
- Supportive and collaborative finance team.
- Varied role with exposure to wider finance activities.

All candidates must live in a commutable location and have their own transportation due to office location. To find out more about this opportunity or to apply, please submit your CV for immediate consideration.
